title: Reverse Words in a String
description: Reverse the order of words and trim extra whitespace.

data.text: Given an input string `s`, reverse the order of the words. Words are separated by one or more spaces. Return a string with a single space between words and no leading or trailing spaces.

data.title: Split filter join O(n)
Two-pass manual O(n)
What improved?
data.text: Manual tokenization avoids allocating an intermediate char array from `Split`. It also lets you skip spaces in a single pass.
